description: The plot illustrates the relationship between coverage and the number of completions (k) for four different Llama model configurations: Llama-3B, Llama-3B + FT, Llama-1B, and Llama-1B + FT. The x-axis, labeled “Number of completions (k),” is on a logarithmic scale ranging from 2⁰ (1) to 2⁸ (256), with tick marks at each power of two. The y-axis, labeled “Coverage,” is on a linear scale ranging from approximately 0.3 to 0.8, with major tick marks at 0.4, 0.6, and 0.8. The Llama-3B line (solid blue with circular markers) starts at ~0.42 at k=1 and steadily increases to ~0.78 at k=256. The Llama-3B + FT line (dashed green with triangular markers) begins slightly lower at ~0.40 and rises to ~0.77, tracking closely with Llama-3B. The Llama-1B line (solid light blue with circular markers) starts at ~0.32 and climbs to ~0.75, while the Llama-1B + FT line (dashed light green with triangular markers) begins at ~0.30 and reaches ~0.73, both showing consistent upward trends but starting at lower coverage than their 3B counterparts. All lines exhibit diminishing returns as k increases, with coverage gains slowing after k=16.
